LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash.label: <color=#FFB25C>Ascendant Flame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash.descripti: Fly up to 150 cells to a standable target cell, leaving a 3-cell-wide burning trail for 15 seconds and burning hostile pawns on the path.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion.label: <color=#FFD37A>Instant Combustion</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion.descriptio: Burn the eyes and brain of hostile pawns within 30 cells, double Life Burn layers, and stun them.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillar.label: <color=#FF7A45>Burning Pillar</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillar.description: Create a long-lasting pillar of fire that burns hostile pawns and deconstructs buildings.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurn.label: <color=#C95CFF>Time Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurn.description: Stop a pawn's ticks for 24 hours or deconstruct a targeted building.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf.label: <color=#FF5C3A>Ashes of Self</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf.description: Spend shield energy or blood to gain Self Burn and create a 5x5 burning field.
